objective: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

description: You are to meet with Windsor at the gates of Stormwind.
What Windsor is about to unveil will shake the very foundation of the kingdom!
Do not attempt to venture there alone, <name>. You must amass an army! Gather your compatriots. To arms!
completion: Before we begin, I ask that you first gather an army. We face a dragon, after all!
